name: Charge-070_0123-optical-flow
description: Benchmark dataset and evaluation for optical flow estimation measuring a model's ability to predict per-pixel motion between image pairs. It focuses on dense motion estimation accuracy across varied scenes and motion patterns and is used to compare optical-flow algorithms and learned models. Metrics emphasize geometric precision of predicted flow fields.
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used by the optical-flow and low-level vision research community; moderately known within that subfield but not a general-purpose benchmark.
